bounded_decoder_batcher.contract: batch input_state/target_ref rows; never copy raw target text into encoder input

checkpoint_policy.contract: no final checkpoint export; temporary checkpoints only under marked output_dir/checkpoints

loss_mask_enforcer.contract: compute only row-authorized losses; forbidden losses must be exactly zero contribution

manifest_dataset.contract: load JSONL rows, split by train/eval/strict_eval, enforce row caps before batching

model_forward.contract: 100M seq2seq forward over encoder packet and bounded decoder targets

optimizer_step.contract: zero_grad -> backward -> clip/log grad norms -> step; disabled until execution authorization

telemetry_writer.contract: write loss, eval, token, gate, sample, delta, cleanup artifacts every probe

tokenizer.contract: encode/decode UTF-8 bytes; preserve budget accounting; no learned tokenizer required

next_best_step: rebuild telemetry writer and tiny model forward/backward only after this contract is audited
